# Cheat sheet

Every function of the engine's modules on one page: its signature and what it does. Import a module with `import * as gfx from 'zinc:gfx'` (or name the functions you use). The full reference with every comment is `zinc doc --std`.

<!-- Generated by `zinc doc --cheatsheet --out docs/cheatsheet.md` from lib/*.d.ts: edit the declarations, not this page. -->

## zinc:gfx

- `const enum Btn { Up = 0, Down = 1, Left = 2, Right = 3, A = 4, B = 5, X = 6, Y = 7, L = 8, R = 9, Start = 10, Select = 11 }`
- `onFrame(cb: (dt: number) => void): void` Register the frame callback; dt in seconds.
- `onResize(cb: (w: number, h: number) => void): void` Calls `cb(width, height)` before the next frame each time the surface changes size; asking for it makes the surface follow the window, unless zinc.json's `resiz…
- `openWindow(title: string, w: i32, h: i32, cb: (dt: number) => void): i32` Opens a window beside the main one and draws it with `cb` every frame: while it runs, the drawing calls, width(), height() and the input are the window's.
- `closeWindow(id: i32): void` Closes window `id` (0: the main one, hidden while others are open).
- `windowOpen(id: i32): boolean` Whether window `id` is open (0: the main one).
- `windowCtl(id: i32, op: i32, s: string, a: i32, b: i32): i32` The raw call behind zinc:system/window on window `id` (0: the main one): op 0 move to a,b; 1 resize to a x b; 2 focus; 3 title s; 4..7 its x, y, w, h; 8 the last id opened; 9 the window being drawn.
- `overlay(draw: (dt: number) => boolean): void` Draws over every frame of the main window, after the program, until `draw` returns false (the loader's fade, zinc.json loading.fadeMs).
- `overlaid(): boolean` Whether an overlay draws (zinc:ui paints its frame again instead of keeping it).
- `onPausedFrame(f: () => void): void` zinc:devtools: `f` runs at each frame while the inspector pauses the program (Zinc.setPaused, F8), when no timer and no frame callback does.
- `width(): i32`
- `height(): i32`
- `clear(color: u32): void`
- `rect(x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, color: u32): void`
- `line(x1: number, y1: number, x2: number, y2: number, color: u32): void`
- `text(x: number, y: number, s: string, color: u32, scale: i32): void` Crisp 8px monospace grid, scaled by `scale` (legacy HUD text).
- `rrect(x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, r: number, color: u32, alpha: i32): void` Rounded rectangle; alpha 0..255.
- `gradient(x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, r: number, c1: u32, c2: u32, vertical: boolean, alpha: i32): void` Linear gradient from c1 to c2 (top to bottom when vertical, else left to right).
- `gradientPaint(x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, r: number, paint: number[], alpha: i32): void` Rounded box filled with a gradient paint record, in the coordinates of the box: [kind, x0, y0, r0, x1, y1, r1, n, (offset, 0xRRGGBB, alpha 0..255) * n] with n stops sorted by offset.
- `border(x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, r: number, width: number, color: u32, alpha: i32): void`
- `shadow(x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, r: number, blur: number, color: u32, alpha: i32): void` Soft drop shadow of a rounded box.
- `polygon(points: number[], color: u32, alpha: i32): void` Filled polygon from flat [x0, y0, x1, y1, ...] points (anti-aliased).
- `path(contours: number[], color: u32, alpha: i32): void` Several contours [count, x0, y0, ..., count, ...], nonzero winding (holes, vector art, Lottie).
- `font(family: string, px: i32): i32` Baked font: family "sans" | "sans-bold" | "mono" | "grid" at the nearest baked pixel size.
- `loadFont(file: string, px: number): i32` A font at exactly `px` pixels from a TrueType file chosen at run time: a baked family ("sans", "sans-bold", "mono", the stem of a .ttf of the assets), the path o…
- `fontAscent(font: i32): i32`
- `lineHeight(font: i32): i32`
- `textWidth(font: i32, s: string, tracking: number): number`
- `drawText(font: i32, x: number, y: number, s: string, color: u32, alpha: i32, tracking: number): void`
- `image(name: string): i32` Image baked from the assets directory (PNG or SVG), by file name.
- `imageWidth(image: i32): i32`
- `imageHeight(image: i32): i32`
- `drawImage(image: i32, x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, alpha: i32, radius: number): void`
- `const enum ImageFlag { FlipX = 1, FlipY = 2, Nearest = 4, Smooth = 8 }` Smooth: a cubic B-spline instead of the linear blend, for a small picture stretched far (a field computed at low resolution): no grid.
- `const enum Blend { Normal = 0, Add = 1, Multiply = 2, Screen = 3 }` How a sprite's colour meets what is under it: Normal paints over it, Add adds (glows, sparks), Multiply darkens (shadows, stains), Screen lightens (light, fog).
- `drawImageRect(image: i32, sx: number, sy: number, sw: number, sh: number, dx: number, dy: number, dw: number, dh: number, alpha?: i32, flags?: i32, rotation?: number, tint?: u32, blend?: i32): void` Draws the source rectangle (sx, sy, sw, sh) of an image, in the pixels of imageWidth / imageHeight, on (dx, dy, dw, dh): a frame of a sprite sheet, a tile.
- `imageFromBytes(bytes: u8[]): i32` Runtime image decoded from the bytes of a PNG or JPEG file (zinc:assets readBytes, a download), with its transparency.
- `imageFromPixels(rgba: u8[], w: i32, h: i32): i32` Runtime image of w x h pixels from RGBA bytes (four a pixel, rows top first), with its transparency: no file format between a picture a program computes and the screen.
- `updateImage(image: i32, rgba: u8[]): void` New RGBA pixels for a runtime image of imageFromPixels (as many bytes as it has pixels times four; fewer: nothing changes).
- `shaderProgram(fragment: string, scale?: i32): i32` A fragment program for drawShader, in GLSL ES 1.00 (WebGL 1's language): its main() sets gl_FragColor from `varying vec2 v_uv` (0..1 across the box, top left fi…
- `drawShader(program: i32, x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, uniforms: number[]): void` Fills the box with the program (at most 32 uniforms, u_p[0].x first), on the GPU; under it what was drawn before, over it what follows.
- `shaderAvailable(): boolean` Whether this display draws drawShader on the GPU (the GL window of a desktop, an Android window whose program made a shader before its first frame); false on th…
- `signalCount(): i32` The system's signals waiting for this frame (safe area, theme, font scale, back, keyboard, IME composition): zinc:ui reads them (docs/ui.md).
- `signalNext(): string` The next signal as `kind args` ('safearea 47 0 34 0', 'theme dark', 'back'), '' when none waits.
- `profSection(label: string): string` Ends the current ZINC_PROFILE section named `label` (prints its numbers and the last frame's hash) and starts the next one; returns the same numbers as one JSON…
- `clip(x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, radius?: number): void` Clips the following draws to the box until unclip(); radius > 0 also clips to its rounded corners (anti-aliased).
- `unclip(): void`
- `translate(x: number, y: number): void` Offset added to the coordinates of the following commands (reset every frame).
- `setTransform(a: number, b: number, c: number, d: number, e: number, f: number): void` A 2D matrix for the commands that follow, after translate, in logical pixels: x' = a x + c y + e, y' = b x + d y + f (the canvas setTransform order).
- `resetTransform(): void`
- `stroke(points: number[], width: number, color: u32, alpha: i32, closed: boolean): void` Stroked polyline [x0, y0, x1, y1, ...] with round joins and caps.
- `createImage(w: i32, h: i32): i32` Runtime image (black) usable with drawImage, and as a render target.
- `destroyImage(image: i32): void`
- `commandCount(): i32` Draw commands recorded so far in this frame, and how many more the frame still takes.
- `commandsFree(): i32`
- `beginImage(image: i32): void` Draw commands until endImage() are rasterized into `image` instead of the screen (tile caches, static layers).
- `endImage(): void`
- `wheel(): number` Mouse wheel / scroll steps this frame (+ = up).
- `pinch(): number` Trackpad pinch scale this frame (1 = none).
- `touchCount(): i32` Multitouch: active touch points this frame.
- `touchX(i: i32): number`
- `touchY(i: i32): number`
- `touchId(i: i32): i32`
- `const enum PenFlag { Down = 1, Eraser = 2, Hover = 4 }`
- `penCount(): i32` Pen (stylus) samples received since the previous frame, oldest first: fast strokes are not lost between frames.
- `penX(i: i32): number`
- `penY(i: i32): number`
- `penPressure(i: i32): number` 0..1
- `penTiltX(i: i32): number` Tilt in degrees (-90..90).
- `penTiltY(i: i32): number`
- `penFlags(i: i32): i32` PenFlag bits: Down (touching), Eraser (eraser end), Hover (in range, not touching).
- `keep(): void` Nothing changed this frame: present the previous one again (retained UIs call this when idle).
- `const enum GamepadButton { South = 0, East = 1, West = 2, North = 3, LeftShoulder = 4, RightShoulder = 5, LeftTrigger = 6, RightTrigger = 7, Back = 8, Start = 9, LeftStick = 10, RightStick = 11, Up = 12, Down = 13, Left = 14, Right = 15, Guide = 16 }` Gamepads (Zinc Next): slots 0 to gamepadCount() - 1; buttons and axes in the W3C "standard" order.
- `const enum GamepadAxis { LeftX = 0, LeftY = 1, RightX = 2, RightY = 3 }`
- `gamepadCount(): i32`
- `gamepadConnected(pad: i32): boolean`
- `gamepadName(pad: i32): string`
- `gamepadButtons(pad: i32): i32`
- `gamepadButton(pad: i32, b: GamepadButton): boolean`
- `gamepadButtonValue(pad: i32, b: GamepadButton): number`
- `gamepadAxis(pad: i32, axis: GamepadAxis): number`
- `gamepadRumble(pad: i32, low: number, high: number, ms: i32): boolean`
- `isDown(b: Btn): boolean`
- `wasPressed(b: Btn): boolean`
- `pointerX(): number`
- `pointerY(): number`
- `pointerDown(): boolean`
- `frame(): i32` Frame counter since start.
- `pixelScale(): i32` Physical pixels per logical pixel of the frame (2 on Retina): size render-to-image layers with it to keep them sharp (an image drawn at its own physical size is…
- `quit(): void`
- `capture(path: string): boolean` Saves the frame on screen (the last one presented, at physical size) as PNG, or BMP when the path ends in .bmp.
- `const enum Mod { Shift = 1, Ctrl = 2, Alt = 4, Meta = 8 }`
- `const enum KeyKind { Down = 0, Up = 1, Repeat = 2, Text = 3 }`
- `const enum Cursor { Default = 0, Text = 1, Pointer = 2, Move = 3, EwResize = 4, NsResize = 5, Crosshair = 6, Grab = 7, Grabbing = 8, NotAllowed = 9 }`
- `wheelX(): number` Horizontal scroll steps this frame (+ = right).
- `pointerButtons(): i32` Pointer buttons held: 1 left, 2 right, 4 middle.
- `modifiers(): i32` Mod bits held now.
- `keyCount(): i32` Keyboard events since the previous frame, in order: key downs/ups/repeats and typed text (text input on).
- `keyKind(i: i32): KeyKind`
- `keyMods(i: i32): i32` Mod bits at the time of the event.
- `keyName(i: i32): string` Key name like DOM KeyboardEvent.key, unshifted: 'a', '1', ' ', 'Enter', 'ArrowLeft', 'F5'...; the UTF-8 text for KeyKind.Text.
- `buttonEventCount(): i32` Mouse button presses/releases since the previous frame, in order (fast clicks are not lost).
- `buttonEventX(i: i32): number`
- `buttonEventY(i: i32): number`
- `buttonEventButton(i: i32): i32` 0 left, 1 middle, 2 right (DOM numbering).
- `buttonEventDown(i: i32): boolean`
- `startTextInput(x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number): void` Text input on (IME, on-screen keyboard) for a field at (x, y, w, h); typed text arrives as KeyKind.Text.
- `stopTextInput(): void`
- `clipboardText(): string`
- `setClipboardText(s: string): void`
- `setCursor(c: Cursor): void`
- `scrollDX(): number` Precise scrolling (trackpads) since the last frame, in pixels, resampled at frame time (+ = up / left).
- `scrollDY(): number`
- `scrollPhase(): i32` 0 none, 1 gesture active (fingers down), 2 ended this frame (fingers lifted: start the inertia), 3 fingers landed, 4 fingers lifted this frame and the OS sends t…
- `escapeByApp(on: boolean): void` true: Escape is an ordinary key for the app (zinc:ui sets it); the HAL no longer quits / leaves fullscreen on it.
- `escapeDefault(): void` The HAL's own Escape action: leave fullscreen, else quit (nothing in kiosk mode).
- `profiling(): boolean` Profiler on (ZINC_PROFILE=1, ZINC_TRACE=file.json, DevTools Tracing): zinc:ui marks its frame phases then.
- `profMark(phase: i32): void` Attributes the time since the previous mark to a phase: 0 app, 1 input, 2 anim, 3 layout, 4 paint.

## zinc:sys

- `args(): string[]` Command-line arguments after the program name.
- `env(name: string): string` Environment variable, or "" when unset.
- `exit(code: i32): never`
- `platform(): string` "macos" | "linux" | "rpi1" | "esp32" | "ps2" | "ps1" | "wasm" | "sim"
- `clock(): f64` Monotonic clock in milliseconds.
- `liveObjects(): i32` Runtime statistics (NFR-16).
- `allocations(): i32`
- `randomBytes(n: i32): u8[]` Random bytes from the OS (arc4random, getentropy, esp_fill_random); a clock-seeded xorshift on ps1 / ps2, which have no entropy source.
- `utf8Encode(s: string): u8[]` The UTF-8 bytes of a string.
- `utf8Decode(bytes: u8[]): string` UTF-8 to string; each invalid sequence becomes U+FFFD, like TextDecoder.
- `onSignal(signal: string, cb: () => void): void` Runs `cb` on the event loop when the signal arrives ('SIGINT', 'SIGTERM', 'SIGHUP', 'SIGUSR1', 'SIGUSR2', 'SIGWINCH', ...); the default action (terminate) no longer happens.
- `kill(pid: i32, signal: string): boolean` Sends a signal to a process ('SIGTERM', 'SIGKILL', ...); false when it failed.
- `pid(): i32`
- `cwd(): string`
- `launchDir(): string` The directory the user ran the program from (`zinc run <project>` starts the program in the project): resolve relative paths given as arguments against it.
- `locale(): string` The system's preferred language as a BCP 47 tag ("fr-FR"): LC_ALL, LC_MESSAGES or LANG when set, else the system's setting.
- `device(query: string, arg?: string): string` A device feature, the backend of the web APIs of zinc:web (navigator.getBattery, wakeLock, onLine, visibility, sensors): a JSON or plain answer, '' when this machine has none.
- `chdir(dir: string): boolean`
- `setEnv(name: string, value: string): void`
- `unsetEnv(name: string): void`
- `envKeys(): string[]` Names of the environment variables, sorted.
- `isatty(fd: i32): boolean` 0 stdin, 1 stdout, 2 stderr
- `write(s: string): void` Writes to stdout / stderr without a newline.
- `writeErr(s: string): void`
- `onStdin(cb: (chunk: string) => void): void` Standard input in chunks (UTF-8 sequences never split); '' at end of input.
- `poll(ms: i32): void` Waits up to `ms` milliseconds for work from outside (a child's output, a signal, stdin) and delivers it.

## zinc:fs

- `readText(path: string): string`
- `writeText(path: string, data: string): void`
- `appendText(path: string, data: string): void`
- `writeTextAsync(path: string, data: string): Promise<void>` writeText on a worker thread: the frame goes on while a large file is written.
- `readTextAsync(path: string): Promise<string>` readText on a worker thread.
- `exists(path: string): boolean`
- `list(dir: string): string[]` Names in a directory, sorted.
- `remove(path: string, recursive?: boolean): boolean` false when it failed; `recursive`: a directory and everything in it (rm -rf).
- `mkdir(path: string, recursive?: boolean): boolean` false when it failed; `recursive`: with missing parents, and true when it already exists (mkdir -p).
- `readBytes(path: string): u8[]`
- `writeBytes(path: string, data: u8[]): void`
- `appendBytes(path: string, data: u8[]): void` Adds the bytes at the end of the file, made when missing (a download written slice by slice).
- `stat(path: string): Stat` Errors read `CODE: op path` (ENOENT, EACCES, EEXIST, ENOTDIR, ENOTEMPTY...).
- `lstat(path: string): Stat` Like stat, without following a symbolic link.
- `readDir(dir: string): DirEntry[]` Entries with their types, sorted by name.
- `rename(from: string, to: string): void`
- `copyFile(from: string, to: string): void` Copies a file; the copy keeps the source's modification time and mode (`rename` across disks throws EXDEV: copy, then `unlink`).
- `realpath(path: string): string` Absolute path with symbolic links resolved.
- `mkdtemp(prefix: string): string` Creates a unique directory `prefix` + 6 random characters and returns its path.
- `tmpdir(): string` $TMPDIR (or /tmp) without a trailing slash.
- `symlink(target: string, path: string): void`
- `readlink(path: string): string`
- `chmod(path: string, mode: i32): void`
- `watch(path: string, cb: (event: string, name: string) => void): i32` Watches a file or the entries of a directory (not recursive): cb('rename', name) when an entry appears or disappears, cb('change', name) when its size or mtime changes.
- `unwatch(id: i32): void`

## zinc:storage

- `get(key: string): string` Persistent key/value store (file on hosts, NVS on esp32).
- `set(key: string, value: string): void`
- `remove(key: string): void`
- `keys(): string[]`

## zinc:net

- `class Headers` Web Headers: case-insensitive names, iteration sorted by name.
- `class Response`
- `fetch(url: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<Response>` HTTP(S) request (libcurl on hosts, esp_http_client on esp32): follows redirects, decodes gzip / br.
- `serve(port: i32, handler: (req: Request) => Reply, tls?: { cert: string; key: string }): i32` Minimal HTTP/1.1 server (server mode): the handler runs on the event loop.
- `serveAsync(port: i32, handler: (req: Request) => Promise<Reply>, tls?: { cert: string; key: string }): i32` Like serve, for a handler that answers later: the reply goes out when the promise resolves (a rejection is a 500).
- `stop(port?: i32): void` Stops the server on `port`; without it, every server.

## zinc:osc

- `send(host: string, port: i32, address: string, numbers: f64[], strings?: string[]): void`
- `listen(port: i32, cb: (m: OscMessage) => void): void`
- `close(): void`

## zinc:mqtt

- `class MqttClient` MQTT 3.1.1 client (QoS 0) over TCP.

## zinc:telemetry

- `connect(target: string): void` Starts streaming JSON lines: "udp://host:port", "stdout" or "file:path".
- `counter(name: string, delta: number): void`
- `gauge(name: string, value: number): void`
- `event(name: string, data: string): void`
- `expose(name: string, get: () => number): void` Sampled at 10 Hz into state_snapshot messages.
- `enabled(): boolean`

## zinc:gpio

- `setup(pin: u8, mode: string, pull: string): void` mode: "in" | "out"; pull: "up" | "down" | "none"
- `write(pin: u8, value: u8): void`
- `read(pin: u8): u8`
- `watch(pin: u8, edge: string, debounceMs: u16, cb: (e: PinEdge) => void): void` edge: "rising" | "falling" | "both"
- `simulate(pin: u8, value: u8): void` Simulator only (macos/linux/sim): drive an input pin as if wired to a button.

## zinc:wifi

- `start(onChange?: (info: WifiInfo) => void, options?: WifiOptions): void` ESP32 (--engine mquickjs).
- `connect(ssid: string, password: string): void` Saves a network and joins it, with no portal.
- `forget(): void` Forgets the saved network: the next start() opens the portal.
- `stop(): void`
- `info(): WifiInfo`
- `scan(cb: (networks: Network[]) => void): void` The networks in range.
- `clock(): string` The local time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS', once the network set the clock (SNTP); '' before.

## zinc:espnow

- `const BROADCAST: string` Every board in range.
- `start(onReceive: (p: Packet) => void, options?: EspNowOptions): void` ESP32 (--engine mquickjs).
- `send(to: string, data: string, onSent?: (ok: boolean) => void): void` Up to 250 bytes of UTF-8 to a board's address or to BROADCAST; onSent says whether the board's radio acknowledged it (true for BROADCAST once sent).
- `address(): string` This board's address, which the others send to.
- `stop(): void`

## zinc:events

- `class Emitter<T>` Typed event channel; emit() is safe from native threads (NAT-06).

## zinc:native

- `requireNative<T extends NativeModule>(name: string): T` `export default requireNative<Spec>('Name')` in native/<name>.spec.ts

## zinc:assets

- `readText(name: string): string` The project's assets: the data entries of the mounted packs (zinc assets build), then the assets directory (zinc run sets ZINC_ASSETS; a built program finds ass…
- `readBytes(name: string): u8[]`
- `exists(name: string): boolean`
- `list(): string[]`
- `class Asset`
- `loadGroup(name: string, onProgress?: (p: Progress) => void): Promise<void>` Loads every entry of the group's packs (<group>.zpk); onProgress gets the bytes done of the total, monotone, the last call with done === total.
- `prefetch(name: string): Promise<void>` loadGroup at background priority; a loadGroup of the same group raises it.
- `unloadGroup(name: string): void` Frees the group's entries that no handle holds (the others when their last handle is released).
- `isLoaded(name: string): boolean`
- `groups(): string[]`
- `mount(path: string): i32` Mounts a .zpk or a directory of them in front of the others (mods and patches over the base packs); the number of packs.
- `unmount(path: string): boolean`
- `writePack(path: string, names: string[], data: u8[][]): void` Writes a .zpk of the entries `names` with the bytes `data` (same order; each entry compressed, with its checksum: docs/zpk.md), for mount().
- `get(name: string): Asset` A handle on a loaded entry; throws when its group is not loaded.
- `stats(): Stats` Resident bytes, their peak, the ram budget (0: none), groups loaded, packs mounted, jobs pending.
- `onReload(name: string, cb: (name: string) => void): void` zinc dev: `cb` runs once the entry `name` (a data entry, an image, `<atlas>.atlas`), changed on disk and rebuilt, has replaced the old one in the running progra…

## zinc:os

- `hostname(): string` Machine information on POSIX hosts (macos, linux, rpi1, rmpp), like Node's os module.
- `homedir(): string` $HOME, else the password database.
- `tmpdir(): string` $TMPDIR (or /tmp) without a trailing slash.
- `arch(): string` 'arm64' | 'x64' | 'arm' | 'ia32' | 'riscv64'
- `type(): string` uname: 'Darwin' | 'Linux'
- `release(): string`
- `uptime(): f64` Seconds since boot.
- `loadavg(): f64[]` 1, 5 and 15 minute load averages.
- `totalmem(): f64` Bytes.
- `freemem(): f64`
- `cpus(): CpuInfo[]` One entry per online CPU (speed in MHz, 0 when unknown).
- `availableParallelism(): i32`
- `networkInterfaces(): NetworkInterface[]` Addresses of the interfaces that are up, flattened (Node groups them by name).
- `userInfo(): UserInfo`

- `JSON.parse(text: string): any` Untyped JSON becomes a Dyn tree (DYN-09): gradual profile only.
- `queueMicrotask(f: () => void): void`
- `weak(target: undefined, ctx: ClassFieldDecoratorContext): void` MEM-13: weak back-reference, does not keep the target alive.
- `pooled(n: i32): (target: Function, ctx: ClassDecoratorContext) => void` MEM-09: N preallocated slots for this class.
- `value(target: Function, ctx: ClassDecoratorContext): void` LNG-10: value class (copied, no header).
- `console.log(...args: unknown[]): void`
- `console.info(...args: unknown[]): void`
- `console.debug(...args: unknown[]): void`
- `console.warn(...args: unknown[]): void`
- `console.error(...args: unknown[]): void`
- `console.trace(...args: unknown[]): void`
- `console.time(label?: string): void`
- `console.timeEnd(label?: string): void`
- `console.timeLog(label?: string): void`
- `console.count(label?: string): void`
- `console.countReset(label?: string): void`
- `console.assert(cond: boolean, ...args: unknown[]): void`
- `console.table<T>(rows: T[]): void`
- `performance.now(): number`
- `setTimeout(f: () => void, ms: number): i32`
- `setInterval(f: () => void, ms: number): i32`
- `clearTimeout(id: i32): void`
- `clearInterval(id: i32): void`
- `unchecked<T>(v: T): T`
